desc.zh: 从二进制数值出发，推导三个首位与被末尾固定的比较长度。
desc.en: Derive three first-one positions and the matching length forced by the final suffix.

concepts.name: Equal binary values and legal cuts
concepts.description: Leading zeros preserve value; cut indices define nonempty parts.

concepts.name: Forced significant suffix
concepts.description: Equal one counts fix starts; the final suffix fixes length and gap requirements.

concepts.name: Aligned prefix invariant
concepts.description: Every checked aligned column must match across all three starts.
